title: wg: protocol-06 §5.4.1.3 receiver can't get room_uri for franking
description: Suggestion. The receiver must rebuild ServerFrankingContext including room_uri to verify, and compare to "the room ID in the received message" (L1821-1835), but neither FanoutMessage (L1925ff) nor Frank (L1580-1584) carries a room URI. Receivers taking room_uri from different places fail verification. mimid takes it from the /notify/{roomId} path (decision mimid-1wgh.5.15). Fix: say where it comes from or carry it in the fanout.
